summary.title: Free Lean Canvas Templates & Examples | Miro
summary.one_liner: Miro's lean canvas templates offer a structured, collaborative whiteboard layout for mapping a business model across sections such as problem, solution, and revenue streams.
keywords: how to fill out a lean canvas
takeaways: A lean canvas splits a business model into sections: problem, solution, key metrics, unique value proposition, channels, customer segments, cost structure, revenue streams, and unfair advantage.
Miro's lean canvas template is opened from its template library, then each section is filled in.
Teams can invite members to the board to add comments and suggestions in real time.
The canvas can be iterated with images, icons, and links, then shared with stakeholders or exported for presentations.
summary.summary: This Miro product page introduces its lean canvas templates as a visual, customizable way to outline a business model and spot challenges and opportunities. It lists the canvas sections (problem, solution, key metrics, unique value proposition, channels, customer segments, cost structure, revenue streams, unfair advantage) and describes a step-by-step workflow: pick the template, fill sections, invite collaborators, iterate, and share or export. The page is mostly promotional and gives no pricing, technical detail, or examples beyond these general claims.
